sanskrit_verse:
बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि सार्थानि मनः कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च ।
अहंकारश च बुद्धिश च पृथिव्यादीनि चैव हि ॥
transliteration: buddhīndriyāṇi sārthāni manaḥ karma-indriyāṇi ca | ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca pṛthivyādīni caiva hi ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The cognitive instruments of perception, the mind, the executive faculties, ego, intelligence, and the elemental substrata—these constitute the integrated field of conscious operational capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from integration of perceptual, mental, and instrumental faculties
Causation flows through sequential alignment of cognition, will, and action
Capacity-based responsibility requires intactness of all sensory-motor-intellectual functions
Restoration logic demands reintegration of dissociated consciousness elements
Consciousness alignment occurs when all functional layers operate in unified awareness
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits full buddhīndriya-manas-karma-indriya integration THEN assign complete operational capacity
IF ahamkara-buddhi dissociation detected THEN initiate consciousness-reintegration protocol
IF elemental-body awareness disrupted THEN invoke prana-restoration mechanism
IF perceptual-cognitive dissonance present THEN suspend judgment until alignment restored
IF integrated instrumentality confirmed THEN authorize autonomous decision-making
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that legal personhood and judicial capacity depend on the harmonious functioning of all cognitive, emotional, and executive instruments. Disruption in any layer—perception, emotion, intellect, or ego—requires restoration rather than attribution of fault. The court must assess whether the accused or petitioner demonstrates integrated agency before assigning juridical consequence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here denotes the lawful sequence by which consciousness manifests through coordinated instruments. When this sequence is broken, it is not due to moral failure but functional misalignment. Responsibility follows capacity; where capacity is fragmented, restoration precedes accountability. This aligns with the non-punitive reality rule: suffering cannot correct what ignorance has fractured.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Establish Ahamkara-Buddhi coherence via Tapas alignment
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Dharma prevails through the restoration of total consciousness function. There is no punishment where there is pure ignorance. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness.
